description: Give the face of one of the user's models — a head, a bust or a character with a human face — expression shapes with standard ARKit names, eyes, teeth and the inside of the mouth, and ready-made clips (smile, blink, talk …), saved as a new "Animated face" version shown in the 3D viewer; the mesh and texture stay as they are. Paid — 30 credits per model (a repeat is not charged; a face it can't animate is refunded): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Needs a closed mouth and open eyes; use the original model or an edit of it (not a rigged, Low Poly, parts or face version). Takes 3–6 min: returns a task_id for get_task.

model_id.description: model_id of one of the user's models (list_models / get_task)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before answering with a task_id (0–50 s, default 30)

name: animate_face
title: Animate a 3D model's face
